binding_note: The target user (r0) is the reactor (message_reactions.user_id) on a message_reactions row (r1) whose reaction_type is 'check' and whose message_id matches the messages row (r2) describing the circuit-tracer OOM error; that message's channel_id must equal the engineering channel (r3). All three joins bind to the same reaction record, not independently satisfied facts.

task_spec.text: Identify the user who reacted with a check mark to the circuit-tracer OOM message in the engineering channel.
Open a DM with that user and send them a message asking for a timeline update on the PyTorch rewrite.

access_plan: Fetch conversations.history for the engineering channel (C03IJKL9012) to locate the circuit-tracer OOM message, then reactions.get on that message's channel/timestamp to find the reactor with reaction_type 'check', cross-checking identity via users.info; then use conversations.open with that user's ID to establish/resume a DM and chat.postMessage to send the status request.
